items.title: Released-model vision full-pipeline CPU P95
items.impact: Cannot claim OCR/barcode/fusion P95 <= 8s or released-model accuracy.
items.rollback: Keep MATCHED/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN behind manual confirmation; do not publish model weights.

items.title: Production identity (HCT-107 real auth)
items.impact: Dev actor header remains the local identity path; production must not enable it.
items.rollback: Keep allow_dev_actor_header false in production settings.

items.title: Manual screen-reader acceptance
items.impact: axe WCAG 2.1 AA is automated; NVDA/VoiceOver path is not signed.
items.rollback: Do not market full accessibility certification.

items.title: Offline production backup rewrite
items.impact: Household erasure writes skip markers; already-shipped disaster-recovery copies are not rewritten.
items.rollback: Restore from last backup and re-apply skip markers on restore.

items.title: Cross-team R3 publication signature
items.impact: This increment records evidence links; it is not a release signature.
items.rollback: Keep #72 open until the project lead signs the checklist.

items.title: starlette 0.46.2 findings under the FastAPI 0.115 pin
items.impact: pip-audit reports known starlette IDs; fastapi>=0.115,<0.116 cannot take starlette 0.47+ without a dedicated upgrade Story.
